subunit: Homodimer and homotrimer; in response to cyclic AMP or calcium; oligomerization is required for scramblase activity. Component of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore complex (mPTPC), at least composed of SPG7, VDAC1 and PPIF. Interacts with SPG7, NIPSNAP2 and SLC25A30. Interacts with hexokinases including HK1. The HK1-VDAC1 complex interacts with ATF2. Interacts with BCL2L1. Interacts with BAK1. Interacts with RTL10/BOP (via BH3 domain). Interacts with amyloid-beta and APP; induces VDAC1 dephosphorylation. Interacts with TMEM41B. Interacts with BCAP31. Interacts with HSPA9; this interaction couples ITPR1 to VDAC1
